editorial.description_en: Blossom seen as a mass rather than as flowers — a pale pink with the red pulled almost out of it.
editorial.description_ja: 遠くから見た花のような、うすい桃色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.900, C 0.034, h 10.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 花 (hana, blossom) + 霞 (kasumi, haze), rendaku to -gasumi. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Blossom Haze" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 花霞. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hana-bie at ΔE00 5.3, sekkai-kabe at ΔE00 11.3, kai-jiro at ΔE00 12.7. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.034 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
